description: Source code for the PreloadDecoder class and its nested classes BitReader and HuffmanDecoder, implementing bit reading, size decoding, and Huffman decoding functionalities for preload data processing.

classes.name: PreloadDecoder::BitReader
classes.description: Handles bit-level reading from a byte array, including methods for reading bits, decoding size, and seeking within the bit stream.

classes.name: PreloadDecoder::HuffmanDecoder
classes.description: Performs Huffman decoding using a provided Huffman tree, decoding characters from a bit stream.

methods.name: PreloadDecoder::BitReader::Next
methods.description: Reads the next bit from the input stream.

methods.name: PreloadDecoder::BitReader::Read
methods.description: Reads a specified number of bits from the input stream into an integer.

methods.name: PreloadDecoder::BitReader::DecodeSize
methods.description: Decodes a size value from the bit stream using a custom encoding scheme.

methods.name: PreloadDecoder::BitReader::Seek
methods.description: Seeks to a specific bit offset within the input stream.

methods.name: PreloadDecoder::HuffmanDecoder::Decode
methods.description: Decodes a character from the bit stream using Huffman coding.

methods.name: PreloadDecoder::Decode
methods.description: Main decoding function that searches for a string within the preload data using Huffman and prefix decoding.
